text:
Nick Paul has gone 15 games without a goal for a Maple Leafs team that has gone nine without a win, and he has become part of the frustration. The Faceoff Circle's Jeff Veillette needled him for it on a night a John Tavares tying goal was waved off. He has two goals on 5.4 expected (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and Toronto has scored about four fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice.

So the slump is real but unlucky. He is playing 16 minutes a night with Tavares and William Nylander since Kirill Marchenko went down, a bigger role than his game is built for. Evolving-Hockey had him in the bottom 4% of forwards for what his team created with him on last season, and Toronto takes 46% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there, about its level without him. He came over from Tampa Bay after 310 games and a long career as a checker. Our range has him around 12 goals.
